entity: The building at 410 Great Rd, Littleton MA and its federal gun-maker licensees
what_we_add: 49 type-07 maker licenses, 16% of Massachusetts' 303; only two US buildings hold 10+ maker licensees
why: The Globe names the mill as the nation's largest single-address cluster with roughly 50 gun businesses, matching our 49. The 80-vendor figures count dealers too, a different measure. Nobody has the type-07 split or the 16%-of-state share.
